decision: Derive a hash-verified POLYSOLVER wrapper whose three hg38 interval tokens match the input BAM contig convention

method_boundary.unchanged: The same three hg38 genomic intervals, caller database, caller algorithm, and region-plus-unmapped input policy are retained.
method_boundary.changed: Only the literal chromosome prefix in the three hg38 interval arguments changes from 6 to chr6 when the BAM header declares chr6.
method_boundary.historical_caveat: New POLYSOLVER results remain not directly comparable with the historical 357/390 result because of the separately disclosed region-plus-unmapped input change. This compatibility correction does not remove that caveat.

failed_pilot_closure.promotion_rule: No output from this failed run, including its four successful caller tasks, may enter a pilot, capacity, production, or registry artifact.

requirements: accept exactly contig 6 or chr6 detected from the BAM header
change exactly three frozen hg38 interval tokens for chr6 and zero for 6
apply the temporary-directory substitution independently and exactly once
emit and revalidate the derived-wrapper SHA-256 and transformation audit

technical_pilot_validation.result: Both WES samples completed all five callers. Each POLYSOLVER audit verified the pinned source/spec, chr6 convention, exactly three interval-token substitutions, and one temporary-directory substitution.
technical_pilot_validation.scope_boundary: This validates only the technical wrapper transformation. The final six-sample storage pilot is rerun after later transport-control changes, and the separate region-plus-unmapped method-change caveat remains operative.
